en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a small town street with early 20th‑century buildings on both sides, a few pedestrians and cars, and a tall church tower with an onion dome and clock rising in the background. In the foreground on the right is a commercial building with the shop name "Schmähl" on the facade. At the bottom is a printed caption identifying the place as the main street and church of Lauchhammer‑Mitte.
